title: Narration (Module 8 — Narration author output, then patched by the TTS synthesizer)
description: Written by /narrate-feature, then patched in place by synthesize-narration.mjs, which fills audio_path, duration_ms and alignment for every line. The two halves are deliberately separate: the language is a judgement call an LLM makes, the durations are a measurement only the TTS provider can supply. Nothing downstream may guess a duration — a line whose audio has not been measured must not be rendered.

language.description: Free-form label for the spoken language, e.g. 'hinglish'. Must match project.config.json's tts.language.

synthesized_at.description: ISO timestamp of the last successful synthesis run. Null before the first.

tts.description: What actually produced the audio, recorded so a cut can be traced to a provider/voice/model rather than assumed.

step_id.description: Joins to a shot in the shot list, or the literal 'intro' / 'outro' for the brand cards.

text.description: The spoken line AND the on-screen caption — one source of truth, so a viewer reading along never sees words that were not said.

text_roman.description: Optional Latin-script transliteration. Never spoken and never displayed; it exists so a reviewer who cannot read Devanagari can still check the script.

audio_path.description: Repo-relative path to the synthesized mp3. Null until synthesize-narration.mjs has run.

duration_ms.description: MEASURED audio length, never estimated. The timeline extends a shot to fit this, which is why a wrong value silently truncates speech.

alignment.description: Per-character timings from the provider, used to highlight the caption in sync with the voice.
